Financial Times :

 Docs: Nvidia stopped reporting Singapore unit revenue in 2025 as it accounted for nearly 50% of global revenue; the unit's revenue rose 72% YoY to $104B in 2025   —  US chipmaker changed its reporting methods as revenues booked through the city-state surged 70 per cent
